senses.gloss: m. (צְרָדָא I) manufacturer or seller of common cloth (or clothes).—Pl. צְרָדוֹיֵי.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 51b">B. Mets. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>בצ׳ דיהבי וכ׳</he> Ms. H. a. R. 1 (ed. <he>צְדָרוֹיֵי</he>, Var. <he>צרד׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4; Ar. <he>צדר׳</he>; older eds. in Rashi <he>צדד׳</he>) it refers to manufacturers &c., who pay four percent. commission.
